Trasforma i disegni di AutoCAD (.dwg) in: Turns AutoCAD drawings (.dwg) into DXF files to save, for other programs or for many drawings at once. To open a DWG in Banco CAD you no longer need this page: Banco CAD opens it directly with «Import DXF or DWG (sketch)». The conversion happens in your browser: the file is not sent anywhere.
Il lettore si prepara al primo file (qua: The reader gets ready with the first file (a few seconds).
Qui compariranno i disegni convertiti, c: The converted drawings will appear here, with version, units, and what Banco CAD will be able to read.
Guarda l'anteprima, poi premi <b>Salva D: Look at the preview, then press Save DXF next to each drawing, or Save all DXFs to get them all in one .zip.
Nel Banco CAD: <b>Progetto › Importa DXF: In Banco CAD: Project › Import DXF or DWG (sketch), then choose the layers (with a .zip of several drawings, also choose the drawing).
Da AutoCAD R1.4 ad AutoCAD 2018. AutoCAD: From AutoCAD R1.4 to AutoCAD 2018. AutoCAD 2019–2025 save in the same format as 2018, so they work too.
Linee, archi, cerchi, polilinee, ellissi: Lines, arcs, circles, polylines, ellipses, splines and blocks come through well. In Banco CAD texts, dimensions and hatches do not go into the sketch: they can only be shown as a reference background. Always look at the preview in the import window.
